name: Can I fix a running toilet myself or should I call a plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I fix a running toilet myself or should I call a plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many minor running toilet issues, such as a simple flapper replacement or adjusting the float arm, can be tackled by a homeowner with basic DIY skills. However, if you're unsure about the cause, lack the right tools, or find the problem persists after your attempts, it's best to call a professional plumber. Incorrect repairs can sometimes lead to further damage or continued water waste.
acceptedAnswer.description: Simple running toilet issues can be DIY, but for complex problems or persistent leaks, it's advisable to call a professional plumber to prevent further damage.
